explanations.answer: They have not listened to His words
explanations.explanation: That's the reason the LORD gives. He says, “…they have not listened to My words, declares the LORD…” (Jeremiah 29:19). The text doesn't hand us a second reason, so we won't go looking for one. He sent those words again and again, which makes this verse sting even more.
